corrections.label: Vocabulary
corrections.description: Consider varying repeated use of « Paris ».
corrections.explanation: Repeating the same noun reduces lexical range — a pronoun or synonym shows more control.
corrections.quoteContext: quelque chose sans rapport avec le texte
corrections.tip: Replace a repeated noun with a pronoun (elle) once it's established.

best_moment: Your two short sentences are both grammatically clean.
biggest_opportunity: Combine the two ideas into one sentence using « parce que » for cause and effect.
improved_answer: Paris est belle et je l'aime beaucoup.
advanced_answer: Paris est une ville magnifique que j'aime énormément pour son charme unique.
